title: Build an MCP server
excerpt: In this tutorial, we'll build a simple MCP weather server and connect it to a host, Claude for Desktop. What we'll be building We'll build a server that exposes two tools: get alerts and get forecast. Then we'll connect the server to an MCP host (in this case, Claude for Desktop): Servers can connect to any client.
